title: Su Passu Torrau - Video tutorial di ballo sardo | Ballamus nois ca sos ballos sunt sos nostros

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher introduces and explains the historical context and characteristics of the dance while demonstrating couples in traditional costumes. He verbally breaks down the counts and footwork structure while close-up camera angles show the precise foot movements.

lesson_structure.note: The host introduces the traditional Sardinian dance Su Passu Torrau of Mamoiada.
Explanation of what 'passu torrau' means in Sardinian dances.
Detailed breakdown of the 6 movements per musical bar for the male step.
Demonstration and breakdown of the male steps with close-up footwork.
Demonstration and breakdown of the female steps with close-up footwork.

cues: Destro destro sinistro destro sinistro sinistro

steps_taught.name: Passo base maschile
steps_taught.description: Six-count step starting with weight on left, moving right then left with constant trembling.

steps_taught.name: Passo base femminile
steps_taught.description: Microscopic steps forward and backward following the same 6-count structure.

what_works: Use of close-up shots focusing entirely on the feet
Clear verbal counting synchronized with foot placement
what_hinders: The host talks over the demonstration without real-time voiceover matching the exact foot counts

quotes.text: Su Passu Torrau è un ballo nel caso specifico abiente a Mamoiada.
La difficoltà in questo passo sta in un tremolio ritmico costante.
Il passo è caratterizzato da sei movimenti per battuta musicale.

evidence_segments.observation: Dancer's feet standing together in traditional shoes.
Dancer stepping right and left with close-up on footwear.
Male dancer performing solo steps with split screen showing upper body and foot close-up.

extraction.distinctive_method: Combining cultural history and folklore explanations with microscopic footwork breakdowns in split-screen format.
